Hi Mina,

Thanks again for taking time to help us evaluate Redwood. We're eager to do an architecture deep-dive focused on data residency (EU/US/APAC) and how routing/fallbacks would work across our regions. Procurement and our Compliance lead (cc'd) will also join for part of the discussion.

Could we aim for a 90-minute session next week? A few slots that work for our team (PST):
- Wed May 5, 09:00-10:30
- Thu May 6, 14:00-15:30
- Fri May 7, 08:30-10:00 (we have APAC folks who can hop on early)

Top items we want covered:
- Residency controls and account-level pinning of model variants
- Network egress and encryption at rest/in-transit (KMS integration)
- Fallback strategies and SLOs across regions
- Any procurement steps we should surface up front

Happy to share a short pre-read. Attendees: Samantha (Compliance), Marco (Platform), Mina — would love your suggested internal presenters.

Best,
Samantha

Aurelius Health
